t2.thesis: AMD enters the print down about 25% over the past month with an implied move of about 9%, but the setup is a coin flip, and the semis cluster base rate and weak past earnings reactions keep me slightly below 50%.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate is 47.9%, below the overall 54%
Last 4 prints had a 25% win rate on the open-to-open measure, with big down reactions after strong beats (-14.5% in Feb)
Stock is down 25% in 1m and 11% in 5d, which lowers the bar, but momentum into prints is only weakly predictive
Implied move of about 9% is high, and a 2.09x ratio of ATM IV to 60d realized vol suggests premium is rich, so a drift is not obvious
Fundamentals are strong (50% revenue growth, EPS estimates revised up 4.8% over 90d, guide of $13B), but this is likely priced in with high expectations
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guide and data-center/MI450 Helios ramp commentary versus a buy-side bar well above the $13B-implied consensus, plus whether Intel's PC warning bleeds into AMD's client outlook.

prior.from: I3 semis cluster t0_hit 0.479 (n=434), versus overall 0.542 and AMC 0.538; semis is the weakest cluster so I lean on it

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report is dated 2026-11-03, which is after today's date (2026-11-02) and after my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information about how AMD's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved from 0.48 to 0.48. The oversold setup and strong estimate revisions offset the weak recent earnings reactions and the semis cluster drag, so no net change.

theses.expected: Stock rises on a beat with a Q4 guide well above consensus and reassuring Helios ramp timing
theses.mechanism: Depressed price into the print (-25% 1m) means a strong data-center guide triggers a relief rally and short covering
theses.wrong_if: The guide is merely in line with the elevated whisper number, or gross margin guidance disappoints

theses.expected: Stock falls despite an EPS beat
theses.mechanism: Pattern from the last 4 prints: beats of 2-16% still produced mostly negative open-to-open reactions, as expectations were high and the AI trade is crowded
theses.wrong_if: Data-center revenue and the guide both clearly beat the buy-side bar and the stock gaps up

theses.expected: Mixed reaction driven by PC and client weakness spilling over from Intel's warning
theses.mechanism: Client and Gaming is about a third of revenue, and a cautious client outlook could offset data-center strength
theses.wrong_if: Client revenue and the outlook are strong and management dismisses the PC concerns

key_observations: Q4 revenue guide versus consensus and the buy-side whisper
Data Center revenue growth and its acceleration in H2
MI450/Helios ramp timing and customer commentary (OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic)
Non-GAAP gross margin guide against about 56%
Client segment commentary and any read-across from Intel's PC warning
Dilution commentary on warrants and the World Labs stock acquisition
